resources.string: Shows the red dot when you type in another app. Hold the dot and speak: RedDot sends the recording to your own RedDot server and types the text into the field.\n\nWith it, RedDot is told when you move into a text field in any app, and sees that field and its text (to put your words in at the cursor), which part of the app\'s screen has the keyboard\'s focus (to find that field: it looks only at the screen\'s layout, never at what\'s written there), the name of its app (to label the note on your phone) and whether the keyboard is showing (to put the dot above it). It doesn\'t read anything else written on your screen or send anything from it, and it stays out of password fields.
